grade.answer_reason: It says yes because the pinned 2.1.3 has `@include "path"` (added in 2.0.0), and it gives the full mechanism from the changelog: paths are relative to the including file, nesting goes up to 8 levels, later keys override the base, and `${ENV}` works in include paths since 2.1.0.
